title: Machine learning screens traditional Chinese medicine compounds for COX-2 inhibitors
summary: Random forest and deep learning models outperformed graph neural networks, and the random forest classifier was selected to screen TCM-derived compounds for COX-2 inhibition under small-dataset conditions. The selected lead compound, dehydrocostus lactone, was experimentally confirmed to have potent COX-2 inhibitory activity. Results are in vitro and the number of compounds tested was not reviewed.
ai_technology: Random forest classifier (compared with deep learning and graph neural networks)
organization: School of Artificial Intelligence and Information Engineering, East China University of Technology, Nanchang, China; Jiangxi Science and Technology Normal University, Nanchang, China

evidence.tested: Experimental COX-2 inhibition assays of prioritized candidates, including dehydrocostus lactone.
evidence.unknown: Selectivity, in vivo activity and clinical relevance; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: A random forest classifier ranked compounds for predicted COX-2 inhibitory activity.
